label: Permanent members of the Security Council
basis: Charter of the United Nations; the Russian Federation from 24 December 1991

label: Elected members of the Security Council
basis: Members listed in the meeting record who are not permanent members

label: Non-members of the Security Council invited to speak
basis: Invited under rules 37 and 39 of the Council's provisional rules of procedure

label: European Union member States
basis: Dated membership (the European Communities before 1993); data_static/memberships.csv

label: African Union member States
basis: UN member States in Africa; Morocco from 30 January 2017 (the Organization of African Unity before 2002)

label: Group of 77 members
basis: The Group's own list of members (g77.org), less China, which says it is not a member (docs/DECISIONS.md, 15); dates of joining and leaving in data_static/memberships.csv (approximate where the Group gives none)

label: Organisation of Islamic Cooperation member States
basis: Dated membership, with suspensions (Egypt 1979-84, Afghanistan 1980-89, Syria 2012-25); data_static/memberships.csv
